title: Minimum Number of Rooms
statement: Each viva has a start time and an end time. A room can hold one viva at a time, and a viva ending at time t frees the room for a viva starting at time t. Find the minimum number of rooms needed.
input_format: The first line contains n. Each of the next n lines has two integers start and end.
output_format: Print the minimum number of rooms.
constraints: 1 ≤ n ≤ 200000; 0 ≤ start, end ≤ 1000000000 and start is less than end.

examples.explanation: The first viva overlaps each of the others, but they do not overlap each other, so 2 rooms are enough.

hints: Only the moments when vivas start or end matter.
Sort all start and end events; process an end before a start at the same time.
Track how many vivas are running and remember the largest value seen.
